FitGear Authority publishes supplement shopping guides for adults who want to understand labels and compare value.

Editorial policy

These are category buying guides, not hands-on product reviews. We do not invent test results, customer testimonials, product rankings, or medical credentials. Sources are linked where relevant. Prices and formulas must be checked with the seller.

Corrections

Report a factual issue through our public issue tracker. Do not include private or medical information.
